gate.title: For Sam
gate.line: A short walkthrough of how I would approach this. I will share the password on our call.

hero.headline: Designing the next release of Acme’s habit product.
hero.sub: Habit apps fail the same way: they nag on their own schedule. I would build the one that lets people set the pace, and keep it that way as it grows.

items.headline: The reminder is the product.
items.note: If a nudge arrives at the wrong moment once, it is muted for good. I would make the timing the user's choice from the first screen.

items.headline: One designer, one thread.
items.note: The same hands should draw the journey, the system and the launch page, so the product sounds like one person wrote it.

story.title: One product from sketch to launch.
story.intro: Orbit is a fictional example: a habit app I founded, where the whole job was trust in the nudge.

chapters.label: The problem
chapters.title: People forgot the app, not the habit.
body: Most habit apps remind people on the app’s schedule. Orbit lets the user choose.

chapters.label: The result
chapters.title: What launched.
body: A public launch in two cities.
